name: Algorithmic Baiting via Semantic Domain
description: Rephrases a path-finding/tree-pruning problem (Steiner tree on a tree) using the precise terminology of Disjoint Set Union and Kruskal's algorithm ("mergers", "consolidate", "transitive"). LLMs relying on surface pattern matching will map this to a greedy MST approach, which incorrectly selects globally cheap edges that aren't on the required paths, causing them to fail.
